note: Yom HaZikaron is Israel's Memorial Day for fallen soldiers and victims of terrorism. At 8:00 p.m. on the evening before, sirens sound throughout Israel and most of the country stand for 1 minute of silence. At 11:00 a.m., the siren sounds for 2 minutes and again the nation stops to remember those who died. Day 19 of the Omer
prompts: What verse spoke to you most today and why?
Did you learn something you need to do in your life?
